results.name: OneBill Software Launches CPQ360.ai, an AI-First CPQ Built to Work With Any Billing Stack
results.content:
## News provided by  
**OneBill Software**  
Aug 06, 2026, 11:00 ET  
SANTA CLARA, Calif., Aug. 6, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- OneBill Software today announced the launch of [CPQ360.ai](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4746161-1&h=3381731635&u=http%3A%2F%2Fonecpq.ai%2F&a=CPQ360.ai), an AI-first configure-price-quote product built to run on top of any billing platform to complete the quote-to-revenue lifecycle. CPQ360.ai governs every quote, rep-built or AI agent-built, under the same pricing rules, margin guardrails, and approval logic, then hands off clean, billing-ready terms through native connectors — live today for Stripe, with additional platforms in active development.  
CPQ360.ai is built for the industries where quoting complexity is highest - telecom, hi-tech, manufacturing, and medical devices; where complex bundles, configurable pricing, and multi-party approvals make manual quoting unworkable.  
Unlike CPQ tools that bolt AI onto an existing UI, CPQ360.ai is API-first, with REST APIs, webhooks, and Model Context Protocol (MCP) access built in from day one. It's billing-platform agnostic by design, so the quote-to-revenue lifecycle completes on whatever CRM, contract, and billing stack a team already runs — Salesforce or HubSpot for CRM, any eSign tool, and any billing platform — **without requiring teams to replace what's already working**.
"We set out to build an agentic-first CPQ that drops into any RevOps stack, on any billing platform," said **JK Chelladurai, Founder and CEO of OneBill Software**. "Our team spent years running quote-to-revenue at scale inside OneBill. CPQ360.ai is built on that experience, so an AI agent and a human rep are held to the exact same rules, on any billing platform."  
CPQ360.ai is available now at [www.cpq360.ai](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4746161-1&h=2113950366&u=https%3A%2F%2Fonecpq.ai%2F&a=www.cpq360.ai), where teams can book a personalized demo or start a free trial.  
**About CPQ360.ai**  
CPQ360.ai is a configure-price-quote product built for agentic execution on an API-first foundation, completing the quote-to-revenue lifecycle on whatever CRM, contract, and billing systems are already in place. CPQ360.ai is a OneBill Software company. Learn more at [www.cpq360.ai](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4746161-1&h=2113950366&u=https%3A%2F%2Fonecpq.ai%2F&a=www.cpq360.ai)  
**Media Contact: Ravi Condamoor | \[emailprotected] | +1 (408) 505 - 4212**  
SOURCE OneBill Software

OneBill is a software designed for subscription management, billing automation, and revenue management. It enables businesses to configure, launch, and manage recurring billing cycles, automate invoice generation, and streamline payment collection processes. The software offers features for rating, charging, invoicing, taxation, and reconciliation, supporting complex pricing models and multi-tiered product catalogs.
OneBill is a Silicon Valley software company that makes cloud-based billing & revenue management software to help organizations quickly launch and monetize their products and services with recurring/ usage-based/ rule-based/ transactional/ hybrid subscription models, automates the entire quote-to-cash and revenue recognition processes, brings channel partners and resellers into a single billing ecosystem, improves process efficiency, enhances customer billing experience, and overall increased bottom-line.
The OneBill software uses a subscription-based pricing model, where charges are typically determined by the number of users, modules, or usage levels required by the customer. The software offers tiered plans, allowing organizations to select features and functions based on operational requirements and scale, with pricing adjusted according to selected options and usage.
